neighbours.label: polysemantic lexical cluster: 'at bay', 'in a position', 'at odds', 'in disarray', 'infatuated'/'infatuation', 'encyclical'/'cyclical', and 'encampment'
fire: Regular vaccination campaigns and sanitation upgrades helped keep cholera outbreaks at bay across coastal towns.
Following the debt restructuring, the utility was finally in a position to modernize its aging substations.
Historians studied several papal encyclicals issued during the late nineteenth century regarding industrial labor.
Monetary analysts argued that the manufacturing slowdown was largely cyclical rather than a permanent contraction.
Throughout his university years he remained thoroughly infatuated with nineteenth-century Italian opera.
Survey teams mapped traces of seasonal nomadic encampments scattered along the dry riverbed.
After three senior engineers resigned simultaneously, the firmware division was left in disarray.
The governor's fiscal projections stood sharply at odds with the independent budget office's forecast.
